messages.home.hero.copy: A mobile-first guide for voters and helpers. Get a simple action checklist, official links, deadlines, and offline fallback steps.
messages.home.info.guidance_copy: Rules and official sources drive the answer. AI does not decide eligibility.
messages.home.info.search_copy: Indexed search is added only state by state after validation and privacy checks.
messages.home.info.official_copy: Final submission and status always happen through ECI, CEO, BLO, or ERO routes.

messages.privacy.title: Privacy
messages.privacy.intro: SIR Saathi is designed to give voter guidance without collecting more data than needed.
messages.privacy.item.accounts: No user accounts are required for the MVP.
messages.privacy.item.raw: Raw electoral roll PDFs and parsed voter exports are not published in this repository.
messages.privacy.item.search: Search results must be scoped, redacted, and rate-limited before public launch.
messages.privacy.item.provenance: Indexed public search stays off until schedule provenance comes from an official source.
messages.privacy.item.share: Shared checklists should not include EPIC, address, or other private voter details.
messages.privacy.closing: Final submission and status checks always happen through official ECI, CEO, BLO, or ERO channels.
messages.methodology.title: Methodology
messages.methodology.intro: Guidance is based on state registry entries, deterministic rules, and official-source links. Source dates are shown as last checked, not as a guarantee that the deadline is still current.
messages.methodology.item.sources: Record official SIR dates and source links by state.
messages.methodology.item.confirm: Ask users to confirm deadlines and eligibility on the official portal before acting.
messages.methodology.item.guidance: Start each state at guidance-only capability.
messages.methodology.item.promote: Promote search only after official schedule provenance, parser validation, redaction, and privacy review.
messages.methodology.item.fallback: Show official fallback links for every action.
messages.methodology.item.share: Keep shared checklists free of EPIC, address, and other private voter details.
messages.data_use.title: Data Use
messages.data_use.public_risk: Electoral rolls are public documents, but bulk voter data can still create privacy and misuse risks.
messages.data_use.prohibited: SIR Saathi does not support voter profiling, campaign targeting, caste or religion inference, or bulk exports.
messages.data_use.purpose: Any indexed search must be limited to voter self-service, source checking, and official-action guidance.
messages.data_use.launch: Public indexed search launches only after official schedule provenance, parser validation, redaction, rate limits, and abuse checks pass.
messages.data_use.share: Forwarded checklists should stay generic and avoid EPIC, address, phone, document, or other private voter details.
messages.directory.title: Search stays off until a state is safe to launch.
messages.directory.intro: SIR Saathi shows search capability transparently, but does not expose public indexed search until validation, privacy review, rate limits, and abuse checks pass.

messages.directory.search.unverified: Indexed public search remains off until current schedule provenance is confirmed from an official source. Use official portals and local BLO/ERO channels for final confirmation.
messages.directory.search.not_ready: Indexed public search is not launch-ready. Use official portals and local BLO/ERO channels for final verification.
messages.directory.search.validated: Validated indexed search can be enabled with abuse protection and scoped queries.
messages.directory.search.guidance: Guidance and official links are available; indexed search remains disabled.

messages.state.safety.title: Use voter information safely
messages.state.safety.copy: Do not post EPIC numbers, addresses, phone numbers, documents, or screenshots publicly. SIR Saathi does not decide eligibility; confirm every submission and result with ECI, the CEO, BLO, or ERO.
messages.find.title: Start with a safe official check.
messages.find.privacy_notice: No name, address, district, constituency, or part number is needed here. Choose a state to get official check steps.
messages.find.indexed_privacy_notice: This state is explicitly enabled for reviewed indexed search. Your name, Assembly Constituency, and optional part number are sent only when you choose the protected search action.
messages.find.not_found: If not found, show missing-name steps
messages.find.name_placeholder: Name as it may appear in the roll
messages.find.result_intro: Use ECI voter services to search for your entry. Use the state CEO portal for state notices and confirm any match through official channels before acting.
messages.find.step_state: Select {state} or the matching state section on the official portal.
messages.find.step_search: Search with the name as it may appear in the roll, then narrow with district, AC, or part number if known.
messages.find.step_spelling: Try common spelling variations before assuming the name is missing.
messages.find.step_contact: If there is still no official match, use the missing-name steps below and contact BLO or ERO.
messages.find.indexed_boundary: Indexed public search is not used here unless a state passes launch readiness, official schedule provenance, privacy, and abuse checks.
messages.search.indexed_notice: This search sends your name and geographic scope to SIR Saathi only after you choose Search. Results remain guidance and must be confirmed officially.
messages.search.verify: Complete the abuse-prevention check before searching.
messages.search.no_results: No possible matches were returned. Try spelling variations and verify on the official portal.
messages.search.invalid_scope: Enter a name of 2–80 characters and a valid Assembly Constituency number. Part number is optional.
messages.search.error_generic: The reviewed-roll search could not be completed. Use the official portal and try again later.
messages.search.error_rate: Too many searches were attempted. Wait before trying again or use the official portal.
messages.search.error_unavailable: Reviewed-roll search is temporarily unavailable. Use the official portal.
messages.search.site_key_missing: Reviewed-roll search is not configured on this deployment. Use the official portal.

messages.guidance.deadline_latest: Check the official portal for the latest deadline.
messages.guidance.missing.title: Act quickly on a missing name
messages.guidance.missing.summary: A missing name during SIR needs fast official follow-up, especially during the claims and objections window.
messages.guidance.missing.search_again: Search again with alternate spelling, age, district, AC, and family details.
messages.guidance.missing.check_roll: Check the draft/current roll through official channels.
messages.guidance.missing.contact: Contact BLO or ERO and keep acknowledgement.
messages.guidance.missing.file_claim: File the appropriate claim before the deadline.
messages.guidance.missing.base_reference: Mention that an older/base-roll record appears to exist when contacting officials.
messages.guidance.new.title: Register as a new voter
messages.guidance.new.summary: Use {form} through official online or offline channels if you are eligible and not registered.
messages.guidance.new.eligibility: Check eligibility for the qualifying date.
messages.guidance.new.prepare: Prepare identity, address, and age proof.
messages.guidance.new.submit: Submit {form} through the official voter portal or ERO/BLO route.
messages.guidance.shift.title: Update your shifted address
messages.guidance.shift.summary: Use the official correction or shift workflow so your roll entry matches your current residence.
messages.guidance.shift.confirm_ac: Confirm whether the move is within the same AC.
messages.guidance.shift.submit: Submit {form} or the official shift workflow.
messages.guidance.shift.verify_station: Verify your updated polling station after disposal.
messages.guidance.correction.title: Correct voter details
messages.guidance.correction.summary: Use {form} for spelling, age, address, replacement EPIC, or similar corrections.
messages.guidance.deceased.title: Report a deceased family member entry
messages.guidance.deceased.summary: Use the official objection or deletion route only with supporting details and documents.
messages.guidance.deceased.confirm: Confirm the entry in the current roll.
messages.guidance.deceased.prepare: Prepare available supporting record for the deceased elector.
messages.guidance.deceased.submit: Submit {form} or contact the local ERO/BLO route.
messages.guidance.duplicate.title: Report or resolve duplicate entries
messages.guidance.duplicate.summary: Duplicate entries should be corrected through official ERO/BLO channels so the valid entry is retained.
messages.guidance.duplicate.note: Note both duplicate entries without sharing them publicly.
messages.guidance.duplicate.contact: Contact the BLO or ERO and ask which entry should remain active.
messages.guidance.duplicate.submit: Submit the official objection or correction form if instructed.
messages.guidance.portal.title: Use offline fallback if the portal fails
messages.guidance.portal.summary: Portal issues should not block SIR action. Contact BLO or ERO before the deadline.
messages.guidance.portal.record: Record the error without sharing private details publicly.
messages.guidance.portal.submit: Submit the relevant form offline and keep acknowledgement.
messages.guidance.existing.check_current: Check your name in the current electoral roll through the official ECI or CEO portal.
messages.guidance.existing.check_notices: Check the official CEO notices to learn which revision process and dates currently apply.
messages.guidance.existing.contact_unverified: If your entry is missing or incorrect, contact your BLO or ERO and use the form they confirm is appropriate.
messages.guidance.existing.check_draft: Check your entry in the draft/current electoral roll through official sources.
messages.guidance.existing.check_final: Check your entry in the final/current electoral roll through the official portal or local BLO support.
messages.guidance.existing.current_remedy: If your entry is missing or incorrect, use the current official enrolment or correction process confirmed by your BLO or ERO.
messages.guidance.existing.file_claim: If it is missing or incorrect, file the appropriate claim during the claims and objections window.
messages.guidance.existing.verify: Verify your name through official sources.
messages.guidance.existing.submit_enumeration: Submit the enumeration form before the deadline if you receive one.
messages.guidance.existing.contact_missing_form: Contact your BLO or local ERO because the enumeration form has not reached you yet.
messages.guidance.existing.submit_received: Submit the received enumeration form as soon as possible and keep the acknowledgement.
messages.guidance.existing.urgent_missing: Treat this as urgent: use the missing-name flow and contact BLO or ERO.
messages.guidance.existing.title: Verify and submit your SIR details
messages.guidance.existing.summary_unverified: Confirm your current roll entry and check the official jurisdiction notice before relying on any SIR dates or steps.
messages.guidance.existing.summary: Confirm your roll entry and complete the SIR enumeration form if you receive one.
messages.guidance.existing.summary_complete: The reviewed revision schedule is complete. Verify the final/current roll and use current official remedies for any missing or incorrect entry.
messages.guidance.new.track: Track the application and respond quickly if officials ask for clarification.
messages.guidance.warning.passed: The listed deadline appears to have passed. Check the official CEO or ECI portal for late remedies or appeal options.
messages.guidance.warning.close: The deadline is very close. Prefer the official portal and also contact the BLO or ERO offline.

messages.assistance.title: Need help from an election official?
messages.assistance.intro: SIR Saathi does not collect complaints or application details. Use an official ECI or state channel.

messages.assistance.portal.description: Register a complaint or suggestion, track an application, or request a call with your BLO.
messages.assistance.ceo_directory.label: State and UT election contacts
messages.assistance.ceo_directory.description: Use ECI's official CEO directory if a state or UT website is unavailable or you need election-office contact details.
messages.assistance.helpline.label: Voter Helpline 1950
messages.assistance.helpline.description: Call 1950 for election information, feedback, suggestions, or complaints.
messages.assistance.email.label: ECI complaints email
messages.assistance.email.description: Use the official complaints address when portal or phone support is not suitable. Send only information ECI requests.
messages.assistance.privacy: Do not post or send voter documents publicly. SIR Saathi does not receive anything you submit through these official channels.
